entries.en: A striped settee faced the empty fireplace.
entries.zh: 一张条纹长沙发正对着空壁炉。

entries.en: The essay questions the primacy of speed over accuracy.
entries.zh: 文章质疑了把速度置于准确性之上的做法。

entries.en: The analysis recorded chloride levels in the water.
entries.zh: 分析记录了水中的氯化物含量。

entries.en: An awkward handshake began their first meeting.
entries.zh: 他们第一次见面以一次尴尬的握手开始。

entries.en: Researchers theorized that the markings served as a calendar.
entries.zh: 研究人员提出理论，认为这些标记起着日历的作用。

entries.en: She distrusted any explanation that sounded too convenient.
entries.zh: 她不信任任何听起来过于省事的解释。

entries.en: The hospital record documents a transfusion during the operation.
entries.zh: 医院记录记载了手术中的一次输血。

entries.en: The festival opened with a lively choral performance.
entries.zh: 音乐节以一场活泼的合唱演出开幕。

entries.en: The cabinet held decades of theater memorabilia.
entries.zh: 柜子里收藏着几十年来的戏剧纪念品。

entries.en: The photograph shows a brigadier inspecting the camp.
entries.zh: 照片中，一位准将正在视察营地。

entries.en: She emphatically refused to postpone the opening again.
entries.zh: 她坚决拒绝再次推迟开幕。

entries.en: The countess donated her portrait collection to the town.
entries.zh: 女伯爵把自己的肖像画收藏捐给了小镇。

entries.en: A cow bellowed beyond the stone wall.
entries.zh: 一头牛在石墙外吼叫。

entries.en: The report discussed inflationary pressures on the economy.
entries.zh: 报告讨论了经济面临的通货膨胀压力。

entries.en: The delegates resumed their discussions on disarmament.
entries.zh: 代表们恢复了裁军讨论。

entries.en: That cheerful fella helped us carry the chairs.
entries.zh: 那个快活的家伙帮我们搬了椅子。

entries.en: The memoir follows a young gunner stationed overseas.
entries.zh: 回忆录讲述了一名驻扎海外的年轻炮手的经历。

entries.en: A bright flyer advertised the neighborhood concert.
entries.zh: 一张鲜艳的传单宣传社区音乐会。

entries.en: The club's AGM will take place in the village hall.
entries.zh: 俱乐部年度会员大会将在村会堂举行。

entries.en: The notice gives useful info about local buses.
entries.zh: 告示提供了有关当地公交车的有用信息。

entries.en: The historian studied unionism among dock workers.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了码头工人中的工会运动。

entries.en: A cracked sleeper lay beside the railway track.
entries.zh: 一根开裂的枕木放在铁轨旁。

entries.en: The archive preserves accounts of the cholera outbreak.
entries.zh: 档案保存着关于那次霍乱暴发的记述。

entries.en: A toy bunny peeped out of the basket.
entries.zh: 一只玩具兔子从篮子里露出头。

entries.en: The agreement applied to combatants on both sides.
entries.zh: 协议适用于双方参战者。

entries.en: The exhibition explores how colonialism reshaped local trade.
entries.zh: 展览探讨了殖民主义如何重塑当地贸易。

entries.en: She twirled the ribbon around her finger.
entries.zh: 她让丝带绕着手指旋转。
